name: The Curse of Eternity
description: When you die, you rise again within 1d4 days with all of your health restored.

name: Path of the Reverent
description: Your connection to the Divine Planes aligns you with the Reverent and their quest to turn unbelievers at whatever cost. Gain +1 Persuasion, +1 Insight and +1 Search.
You gain the Divine language and gain +1 Spell Damage

name: Paladin
description: You gain +1 Block and +1 Damage with Melee Weapons

name: Action : Gifted Light
description: You create a beam of divine illumination at a location within 20 units that sheds off 3 units of light, penetrating magical darkness. When a dark or undead creature willfully steps into or ends their turn in this light, it flashes and deals divine damage equal to your level. The light lasts until you willfully end it or use this action again.

name: Lesser Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Novice Spells from the Divine school of magic.

name: Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Journeyman Spells from the Divine school of magic.

name: Angelic Wings
description: You are able to sprout angelic wings at will, granting you a flight speed equal to your movement speed. This is natural flight and requires that the character take at least one Move Action on their turn, or they fall at the end of it.

name: Action [Daily] : Flames of Rebirth
description: You touch a humanoid that has died within the last hour, and attempt to bring them back to life by rolling a 1d4. On a 2 or higher, the creature is brought back to life with full health, with all conditions cured and any injuries healed. On a 1, the spirit is guided to one of the Divine Realms. If a humanoid is targeted by this spell after being brought back to life by it, they are only brought back on 3 or higher.

name: Greater Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Expert Spells from the Divine school of magic. Additionally, gain +1 Spell Attack and +1 Spell Damage.

name: Tainted
description: You do not gain benefits from consumables such as Potions, Food or Snacks and cannot be affected by Spells that restore Health. However, you no longer need to eat or breathe. You also gain Immunity to the Sleep, Poisoned, Exhausted and Diseased Conditions.
You have a connection with the Spectral Plane, or one of it's adjacent planes, manifesting in minor or major changes to your appearance. You have the Undead and Humanoid types.

name: Minor Planar Magic
description: You learn 4 Beginner Spells from the Divine school of magic.

name: Path of the Ardent
description: Your connection to the Divine Planes aligns you with the Ardent and their quest for knowledge and charity. Gain +1 Animals, +1 Academics and +1 Medicine.

name: Divine Lineage
description: You have been infused with agic from the Plane of Divinity. Learn the Divine Language and gain +3 Divine and +3 Dark Mitigation. You have both the Divine and Humanoid Creature Types.

name: Path of the Ardent
description: Your connection to the Divine Planes aligns you with the Ardent and their quest for knowledge and charity. Gain +1 Animals, +1 Academics and +1 Medicine

name: Path of the Reverent
description: Your connection to the Divine Planes aligns you with the Reverent and their quest to turn the unbelievers. Gain +1 Persuasion, +1 Insight and +1 Search

name: Divine Blessing
description: You can touch the power bestowed upon you from the Divine Plane. Gain +1 Spell Attack and learn 3 Beginner and 3 Novice Divine Spells.

name: Radiant Smith
description: Your connection to the Divine Planes allows you to weave radiant energy into weapons and armors, gaining +1 Smithing. Additionally, weapons you forge deal an extra 1d4 Divine Damage, improving to 1d8 at level 7 and 2d6 at level 11. Armor you forge gains +1 Dark Mitigation, improving to +2 at level 7.

name: Free Action : Angelic Wings
description: You sprout feathered wings that grant you a Flight Speed of 8 until the end of your turn, at which point you fall to the ground.

name: Action [Daily] : Grant Favor
description: You Target a Creature within 10 Units and lend them your blessing. The next time they recover Health before the start of your next turn, double the amount restored. If the affected Creature is restored to full Health, they are also cured of any Wounded or Exhaustion Conditions.

name: Spectral Lineage
description: You have been infused with magic from the Spectral Plane. Learn Deadspeak and gain +4 Dark Mitigation and Immunity to the Bleeding Condition. You have both the Undead and Humanoid Creature Types.

name: Semi-Corporeal
description: Spectral magic has altered your presence on the Material Plane. Gain +2 Physical Mitigation.

name: Dark Mind
description: Your mind has endured the shadows of the Spectral Plane. Gain +1 Resilience and +1 Resistance.

name: The Spectral Weave
description: Your connection to the Spectral Plane allows you to channel dark magic with ease as you pull upon the corrupted weave. Gain +1 Spell Attack and learn 3 Beginner and 3 Novice Necromancy Spells.

name: Shadow Eyes
description: Your connection with the Spectral Plane has caused your eyes to pierce the darkness around you. Gain Deadsight and +1 Search.

name: Action : Possess Undead
description: You Target an Undead Creature that still has its Reaction available within 10 Units and force a contest of wills, rolling a Contested Concentration Check. A thrall or allied Undead Creature fails this Check automatically. On a success, the Creature immediately either uses an Opportunity Attack against a Target of your Choice or takes the Move Action.

name: Action : Driftwalk
description: While on the Material Plane, you turn into mist as your physical body becomes mirrored in the Spectral Plane and you Move up to 10 Units to a point you can see. You can pass through Creatures and Objects and do not provoke Reactions and cannot take Damage during your Movement.
